physical_subject: Does a fixed step beyond a line always produce a parallel line?
relationship: A fixed ray-wise offset from a line creates a conchoid branch; its perpendicular height gain is the step length times cosine of the angle from the normal.
operation: Compare equal steps along rotating rays with equal perpendicular steps from a straight guide.
closest_prior: old dot-product/projection introduction; objects/03-shadow: sun-angle proportions
substantive_difference: Compares two fixed-distance offset definitions to generate distinct loci; a ray-wise conchoid branch versus a perpendicular parallel line. No generic dot-product lesson or shadow-height measurement.
